pages.text: The wind was very strong today. Nono's home was beneath the roof.
A narrow gap had opened in the wall. Nono wanted a warm sleep tonight.
He carried dry grass in his beak and pressed it into the gap.
Gugu called from the alley. Nono dropped the grass and fluttered away.
They played on the snow for a long time. The dry grass stayed where it was.
Night came. Cold wind whistled through the gap.
Nono shivered. However he closed his eyes, he could not sleep.
In the morning, Grandpa Badger was sealing gaps in the shop. "Leave no gaps, and wind stays out."
Nono brought more dry grass in his beak. This time, he sealed the whole gap.
At night, no wind came in. Nono fell into a snug, comfortable sleep.
